description.narrative:
The project will finance high-priority electricity grid modernization investments both in transmission and distribution system in Nepal under the following outputs:
Output 1: Electricity transmission capacity in project areas strengthened and modernized.
Output 2: Electricity distribution system in project areas modernized.
Output 3: Capacity of NEA and electricity users in project areas strengthened.
These outputs will result in the following outcome: access to efficient grid electricity supply in Nepal improved. The project will be aligned with the following impact: investments in industrial and commercial hubs promoted.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Capacity of NEA to implement its corporate development plan strengthened Indicator: At least 30 eligible NEA staff (including 30% eligible women) reported increased knowledge on operating automated grid substations (2019 baseline: 0) (OP 2.2) Achievement: 10 Progress/Status: Training will be taken up by PSC upon completion of construction of automation of grid substation. Data Source: Pre- and post-training assessments

Output: Capacity of NEA to implement its corporate development plan strengthened Indicator: At least 30 eligible NEA staff (including 30% women) reported increased knowledge on NEA's corporate development plan (2019/2020-2023/2024) (2019 baseline: 0) (OP 2.3.1) Achievement: 10 Progress/Status: Trainings are being planned after the launch of new Corporate Development Plan of NEA. Data Source: Pre- and post-training assessments

Output: Capacity of NEA to implement its corporate development plan strengthened Indicator: At least two key actions from NEA's GESI strategy and operational guidelines implemented in NEA's regional offices (2019 baseline: 0) Achievement: 2 Progress/Status: Trainings on Leadership and Management Skills and Customer Service targeting women staff from provincial offices will be planned in consultations with NEA central and provincial offices. With progress, the indicators and targets will be monitored and reported. The tentative budget plan for the above training has been prepared which has to be finalized and approved by the NEA management. Data Source: NEA progress reports

Output: Electricity distribution system in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: At least 2,000 electricity consumers in project areas (including at least 30% women and 30% members of excluded and vulnerable disadvantaged groups) reported increased knowledge on safe and efficient energy use. (2019 baseline: 0) Achievement: 1000 Progress/Status: Training materials have been prepared by PSC and are being finalized. Awareness program on "Safe and efficient use of Energy" conducted benefitting 674 electricity consumers with 63.35% women participation. Data Source: NEA project progress reports

Output: Electricity distribution system in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: Distribution command and control center in Kathmandu commissioned with at least 30% female staff. (2019 baseline: 0) (OP4.3.1) Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: Construction of Data Centre has been completed. Data Source: NEA progress reports

Output: Electricity transmission capacity in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: 34 existing grid substations throughout the country automated (2019 baseline: 0) (OP 4.1.2) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Contract for Grid Substation Automation in 39 substations was signed on 19 December 2022. Works are ongoing at all 39 grid substations and 6 Master Control Centers (MCCs). Works in the substations under Attariya grid is 90% complete, Pokhara grid is 75% complete, Hetauda grid is 50%, Dhalkebar grid is 50% complete, and Duhabi grid is 30% complete. MCC at Pokhara is 95% complete while those at Hetauda and Attariya are 50% complete. The rest of the MCC at Butwal, Inaruwa, and Dhalkebar are less than 40% complete. The Mission noted that the works had to be managed based on the shutdowns NEA can provide. Based on this all the works are expected to be completed by March 2027. Data Source: NEA progress reports

Output: Electricity distribution system in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: Distribution system consisting of 30 km of 33 kV distribution lines in Morang district and four automated substations of 32 MVA 33/11 kV in various parts the country commissioned, benefiting 134,000 households with improved supply (Borang, Keraun, Madichaur, and Pantang) (2020 baseline: 0) (OP 1.3.1) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: 1. Madichaur (Khungri) 132 kV substation: All the major works have been completed for the bay extension at Ghorahi substation and Khungri substation.
2. Borang 132 kV substation: The works at has started with the construction of retaining wall after no works in the entire original contract duration.
3. Pangtan 132 kV substation: Staff quarters, control room building, equipment foundation, and drainage are under construction at Pangtan substation. Equipment foundation is complete for bay extension at Barhabise substation. Power transformer and other major equipment have been delivered at site. The works are expected to be completed within December 2026
4. Keraun 132 kV substation: All the major works are completed except for the erection of dead end LILO tower, installation of substation automation system, and testing and commissioning. All the works are expected to be completed within December 2026.
Data Source: NEA progress reports

Output: Electricity transmission capacity in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: 25 km of 220 kV and 104 km 88 km of 132 kV new transmission lines constructed (Dandakhet-Rahughat 132 kV transmission line: 25 km, Madichaur-Gorahi 132 kV transmission line: 40 km, Borang-Lapang 132 kV transmission line: 23 km, Nepalgunj-Kohalpur transmission line 132 kV, 10 km, Chovar-Lagankhel transmission line 132 kV: 6 km, Lapang-Ratomate 220 kV transmission line: 25 km) (2020 baseline: 0) (OP 4.1.2) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: 1. Dadakhet-Raughat 132 kV Transmission line: Out of 78 towers, 76 tower foundation have been completed and 75 towers have been erected. Out of 24.98 km, 11.5 km of stringing completed.
2. Ghorahi-Madichaur 132 kV Transmission Line: Out of 122 towers, 105 tower foundation have been completed, and 94 towers have been erected. 12.69 km of stringing completed.
3. 132 kV Borang-Lapang and 220 kV Lapang-Ratmate Transmission Line: Out of 70 towers, 12 tower foundation have been completed, and tower erection have just started.
4. Nepalgunj-Kohalpur 132 kV Transmission Line: Construction is yet to start for 8.96 km of transmission line with 38 towers. Land acquisition for the tower foundation is yet to be completed with only compensation rate determined.
5. Chovar-Lagankhel 132 kV Transmission Line: The laying of HDPE pipe and construction of joint bays are complete except in the few sections. Other major works remaining is construction of cable bridge for Bagmati crossing, laying of the cables, and cable terminations. The permit to work on the road from Department of Roads is suspended with the onset of the monsoon and works will start after the monsoon likely in September. Major supply remaining is 50% of the cable. The contractor is expected to complete the works by December 2026. Data Source: NEA progress reports

Output: Electricity distribution system in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: New smart meters for 350,000 customers in Kathmandu Valley installed (2019 baseline: 100,000) (OP 4.2.2) Achievement: 100000 Progress/Status: Due to unavailability of funds required, NEA has proposed to part finance the project through the upcoming SASEC Electricity Transmission and Distribution Strengthening Project (ETDSP). The present plan is to finance $1 million from EGMP, $40 million ETDSP, and the remaining $8 million from the government/NEA sources. Data Source: NEA progress reports

Output: Capacity of NEA to implement its corporate development plan strengthened Indicator: Accounting manual to ensure full compliance with NFRS updated and approved by NEA management by December 2023. (FY2019 baseline: NEA accounting manual is in place, but is not based on NFRS) (OP 4.2.2, OP 6.1, OP 6.1.4) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: NEA has prepared the NFRS accounting manual with the support of expert provided through ADB's technical assistance. The final manual was submitted in June 2026. It is under process of management approval and expected to be approved within 2026. Data Source: Copy of approved accounting manual Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: n Target year: 2026 Target value: y Actual value: 0

Output: Capacity of NEA to implement its corporate development plan strengthened Indicator: Operations manual to commence operation of NEA's NPTCL (as a separate entity) completed by December 2022 (2019 baseline: company established but trading not started) Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: ADB through its technical assistance supported to prepare a draft operations manual for Nepal Power Trading Company Limited, a subsidiary of NEA. Data Source: Copy of operations manual Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: n Target year: 2026 Target value: y Actual value: 1

Output: Electricity distribution system in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: Enterprise resource planning and revenue management system implemented (2020 baseline: 0) (OP 4.2.2, OP 6.1.4) Achievement: 0.5 Progress/Status: RMS: The RMS has become operational in Balaju distribution center. Data migration is ongoing at Lagankhel and Thimi distribution centers, which are next in line to be operational. There are altogether 129 distribution centers which need to transit from existing M-power system of NEA to RMS.
ERP: Bids opened and in technical bid evaluation stage. Data Source: NEA project progress report Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: n Target year: 2026 Target value: y Actual value: 0.5

Output: Electricity transmission capacity in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: Existing 144 km transmission lines (132 kV and 66 kV) upgraded with more efficient high-temperature low-sag conductors in Province 1, Province 2, and Bagmati Province (2020 baseline: 0) (OP 4.1.2) Achievement: 122 Progress/Status: Out of 297 circuit-km of conductor stringing, 213 circuit-km (72%) of the conductor stringing is complete.
In the sections within Kathmandu: (i) Syuchatar-Balaju: This section is complete. (ii) Matatirtha -Syuchatar: In this section 400m is remaining, and (iii) Syuchatar-Teku: This section is yet to be started.
In the sections outside Kathmandu: (i) Hetauda-Kamane-Piluwa: This section is complete. (ii) Piluwa-Chapur: One circuit is complete and the second circuit to be completed once shutdown is available. (iii) Chapur-Nawalpur: Out of 30 km, 15 km is complete. (iv) Nawalpur-Dhalkebar: Out of 40 km, 36 km of one circuit and 36 km of second circuit is complete; and (v) Chapur-Dhalkebar: Works in 14 km of this section could not be started due to local obstruction. Data Source: NEA progress reports Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2020 Baseline value: n Target year: 2026 Target value: y Actual value: 122

Output: Electricity transmission capacity in project areas strengthened and modernized Indicator: New automated 220 kV grid substations totaling 400 MVA in Lapang and Rahughat; and 132 kV grid substations totaling 838.5 MVA 361.5 MVA installed in Borang, Dandakhet, Keraun, Lapang, Madichaur, Pantang, Rahughat, Lagankhel, Nepalgunj, Dumkibas, Mulpani (2019 baseline: 0) (OP 4.1.2) Achievement: N Progress/Status: 1. Dandakhet 132 kV substation: All the major works have been completed at Dadakhet substation with testing and commissioning of the equipment and finishing works under progress.
2. Raughat 220 kV substation: and Raughat: All the major works have been completed except erection of 220 kV and 132 kV GIS, which is ongoing. Finishing works are also ongoing.
3. Madichaur (Khungri) 132 kV substation: All the major works have been completed for the bay extension at Ghorahi substation and Khungri substation..
4. Lapang 220 kV substation: The construction of transformer foundation is complete and construction of retaining walls, boundary walls, and drains are ongoing. 220/132 kV power transformers have been delivered at site and erected on the foundation.
5. Borang 132 kV substation: The works at has started with the construction of retaining wall after no works in the entire original contract duration.
6. Pangtan 132 kV substation: Staff quarters, control room building, equipment foundation, and drainage are under construction at Pangtan substation. Equipment foundation is complete for bay extension at Barhabise substation. Power transformer and other major equipment have been delivered at site. The works are expected to be completed within December 2026
7. Nepalgunj 132 kV substation: Power transformers and lightening arrestors are the only major equipment that has been supplied. Designs and drawings are yet to be approved for CRP, SAS, circuit breakers, and power and control cables. Gantry structures and communication equipment are approved but yet to be manufactured.
8. Dumkibas 132 kV substation: Installation of major equipment completed.
9. Mulpani 132 kV substation: The substation has been commissioned. Only minor punch list items are remaining to be completed.
10. Lagankhel 132 kV substation: All the major equipment has been supplied. 132/11 kV 45 MVA transformer has been installed. Control room building and GIS hall are mostly complete except for the finishing works. The main works remaining are construction of foundation for and erection of 132/66 kV, 63 MVA transformer that is to replace the existing transformers and the finishing works.
11. Keraun 132 kV substation: All the major works are completed except for the erection of dead end LILO tower, installation of substation automation system, and testing and commissioning. All the works are expected to be completed within December 2026.
12. Ghorahi substation (Bay extension): All the major works have been completed for the bay extension. Data Source: NEA progress reports Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2019 Baseline value: n Target year: 2026 Target value: y Actual value: N
